source.initial_project_idea: A hotel wants an online booking system to reduce phone bookings, avoid double bookings, and allow customers to check room availability and book rooms online.

goals_and_objectives.statement: Reduce staff time spent handling room bookings by phone.
Allow customers to check room availability and book rooms online.
Reduce booking mistakes such as double bookings and incorrect dates.

functional_requirements.statement: The system shall allow customers to search available rooms by date and number of guests.
acceptance_criteria: Customer can select check-in and check-out dates
Customer can enter number of guests

functional_requirements.statement: The system shall allow customers to book an available room online.
acceptance_criteria: Customer can choose an available room

functional_requirements.statement: The system shall prevent double bookings for the same room and date.
acceptance_criteria: System checks room availability before confirming booking
System does not allow two confirmed bookings for the same room on the same date

functional_requirements.statement: The system shall send booking confirmation to the customer.
acceptance_criteria: Confirmation includes booking reference, room details, and booking dates

functional_requirements.statement: Reception staff shall be able to view and manage bookings.
acceptance_criteria: Staff can search bookings by customer name or booking reference

functional_requirements.statement: The hotel manager shall be able to manage room information.
acceptance_criteria: Manager can mark rooms as unavailable

non_functional_requirements.statement: The system should be easy for customers and staff to use.
The system should protect customer personal information.
The system should show search results quickly.

data_requirements.name: Customer
data_requirements.purpose: Used to identify the customer and send booking confirmation.

data_requirements.name: Room
data_requirements.purpose: Used to display and manage available hotel rooms.

data_requirements.name: Booking
data_requirements.purpose: Used to record customer room bookings.

constraints.statement: The prototype will focus on room search, online booking, booking management, and room management.
The system should be developed as a web-based prototype.
The prototype should be completed within one university semester.

success_criteria.statement: The system reduces the need for customers to phone the hotel for room bookings.
success_criteria.measure: Compare number of phone bookings before and after system use.

success_criteria.statement: The system reduces double booking mistakes.
success_criteria.measure: Number of double booking incidents recorded.

priorities_and_preferences.statement: Room search, online booking, double booking prevention, and booking confirmation are the highest priority features.
Booking reports and advanced manager dashboard features are optional if time allows.

risks.statement: If room availability is not updated correctly, customers may still experience booking errors.
Customer personal data may be exposed if security is not handled properly.

assumptions.statement: Customers have internet access and are willing to book rooms online.
Hotel staff will keep room availability information up to date.

resources.statement: Reception staff and hotel manager will provide feedback during testing.
A web development environment and database will be required for the prototype.
